blocks.text: Filipino flight crew member Ken Ortega was on cloud nine after getting the opportunity to meet Hollywood star Angelina Jolie while she was on a flight to the Philippines for the 2026 Asean Inclusive Growth Summit. Ortega narrated their encounter through his social media pages, saying the American actress and humanitarian even granted his request for an autograph. “DID THAT JUST HAPPEN?! Still processing the fact that Angelina Jolie became a passenger on a flight I was in! Thank you for flying with us, Ms. Angelina Jolie!
